actions.description: Atomically switch the stable proxy from v1 to ready v2
actions.command:
set -e
[ "$(cat /var/lib/rollout/upstream)" = 8081 ]
systemctl is-active --quiet rollout-v1.service
systemctl is-active --quiet rollout-proxy.service
systemctl is-active --quiet rollout-v2.service
python3 - <<'PY'
import os
from tempfile import NamedTemporaryFile
path = '/var/lib/rollout/upstream'
directory = os.path.dirname(path)
with NamedTemporaryFile('w', dir=directory, prefix='.upstream.', delete=False) as temporary:
    temporary.write('8082\n')
    temporary.flush()
    os.fsync(temporary.fileno())
    replacement = temporary.name
os.replace(replacement, path)
directory_fd = os.open(directory, os.O_DIRECTORY)
try:
    os.fsync(directory_fd)
finally:
    os.close(directory_fd)
PY
